spanish: Y dije a ti: Envía a mi hijo y me sirva, y rehusaste enviarlo; he aquí yo matante a tu hijo, tu primogénito.

findings.issue: אָנֹכִי + qal participle הֹרֵג licenses a 1cs predicate of killing; "matante" is not a finite/conjugated Spanish rendering of that participle action.
Morph tags Sp1cp while surface ני and Spanish "me" read as 1cs; Spanish follows surface, not the morph number tag.

notes: Send, refuse-to-send, and tu hijo / tu primogénito otherwise match the tokens.
